extracted.intended_audience: applicants, European patent attorneys/agents, and EPO examiners
extracted.subtask_description: Table of contents and chapter headings from the EPO 'Guidelines for Examination' describing the standards and topics governing filing, search, substantive examination, opposition, procedural matters, patentability, amendments and corrections for European patent applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing of applications and examination on filing
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and procedures relating to filing a European patent application and the initial examination carried out at filing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part A, Chapter II of the Guidelines for full procedural and formal requirements (detailed guidance is in the full chapter).

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination of formal requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and checks for formal requirements that an application must meet under the EPC and EPO practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part A, Chapter III for the detailed checklist and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special provisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Special rules and exceptions applicable during formalities examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part A, Chapter IV for the scope and application of special provisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications concerning formal deficiencies; amendment of application; correction of errors
rubrics_metrics.description: How the EPO communicates formal deficiencies to applicants and the procedures and criteria for amendment or correction of applications and errors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part A, Chapter V for procedures, time limits and acceptable corrections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication of application; request for examination and transmission of the dossier to examining division
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing publication, requesting substantive examination and transmission of the file to the examining division.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part A, Chapter VI for timing, required documents and procedural steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Languages
rubrics_metrics.description: Language requirements for filing, prosecution and proceedings before the EPO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part A, Chapter VII for accepted languages, translations and language-related procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Common provisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Provisions common to multiple formalities-related procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part A, Chapter VIII for cross-cutting rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Drawings
rubrics_metrics.description: Formal requirements and standards for drawings submitted with a European patent application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part A, Chapter IX for format, clarity and amendment rules for drawings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Fee rules, payment requirements and consequences of non-payment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part A, Chapter X for fee schedules, deadlines and fee-related procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inspection of files; communication of information contained in files; consultation of the European Patent Register; issuance of certified copies
rubrics_metrics.description: Rights and procedures for inspection of EPO files, access to the Register and issuance of certified copies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part A, Chapter XI for practical steps and restrictions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Characteristics of the search
rubrics_metrics.description: Quality criteria and characteristics that define an EPO prior-art search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part B, Chapter III for what constitutes an adequate search and expected standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search procedure and strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: Methodology and strategy to be followed during the EPO search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part B, Chapter IV for recommended procedures and search tactics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preclassification, IPC (routing) and official CPC classification of European patent applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for preclassification, IPC routing and assigning official CPC classes to applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part B, Chapter V for classification practice and implications for searching.

rubrics_metrics.name: The state of the art at the search stage
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition and assessment of the relevant state of the art when conducting the search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part B, Chapter VI for how prior art is considered during search.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity of invention (search stage)
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria for assessing unity of invention at the search stage and its effect on the scope of the search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part B, Chapter VII for assessment methodology and consequences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subject-matter to be excluded from the search
rubrics_metrics.description: Categories of subject-matter that are excluded from the EPO search documentation and practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part B, Chapter VIII for examples and rationale.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search documentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for documenting the search process and the references found.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part B, Chapter IX for documentation requirements and form of records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search report
rubrics_metrics.description: Content and form requirements for the EPO search report issued to applicants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part B, Chapter X for report structure and mandatory elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: The search opinion
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on the search opinion that accompanies the search report and interprets search results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part B, Chapter XI for scoring, explanation and examiner expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formal requirements to be met before the division starts substantive examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Conditions and formal checks that must be satisfied before substantive examination begins.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part C, Chapter II for the list of prerequisites and how compliance is verified.

rubrics_metrics.name: The first stage of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural and substantive matters addressed in the initial stage of substantive examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part C, Chapter III for examiner actions and applicant interactions at the first stage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination of replies and further stages of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: How examiner considers applicant's replies and the further stages until resolution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part C, Chapter IV for assessment criteria and iterative examination steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: The final stage of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and procedures applied at the final stage leading to grant or refusal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part C, Chapter V and the Annex for marks indicating amendments or corrections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time limits and acceleration of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on time limits, options for accelerated processing and related criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part C, Chapter VI for applicable requests, fees and conditions for acceleration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other procedures in examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Other procedural matters that may arise during substantive examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part C, Chapter VII for special procedural treatments.

rubrics_metrics.name: The opposition division; opposition procedure and substantive examination of opposition
rubrics_metrics.description: Structure and procedural/substantive criteria governing oppositions, including examination and decisions by the opposition division.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part D, Chapters II–V for grounds, admissibility, evidence handling and assessment standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure for the examination of the opposition; details and special features of the proceedings; decisions of the opposition division; costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Detailed procedural standards for conducting opposition proceedings, decision-making and cost awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part D, Chapters VI–IX for timelines, hearings, decision content and cost rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limitation and revocation procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural and substantive rules for limitation and revocation of European patents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part D, Chapter X for filing, examination and effects of limitation/revocation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications and notifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and formalities for communications and notifications between parties and the EPO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part E, Chapter II for accepted forms, service rules and electronic communication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Oral proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing oral proceedings before the EPO, including conduct, requests and languages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part E, Chapter III for procedural rights, conduct and consequences of oral hearings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Taking and conservation of evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for submission, taking and preservation of evidence in EPO proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part E, Chapter IV for admissibility, timing and assessment of evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination by the EPO of its own motion; facts, evidence or grounds not submitted in due time; observations by third parties
rubrics_metrics.description: How the EPO may raise issues of its own motion and deal with late-submitted facts or third-party observations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part E, Chapter VI for the limits and procedures for admitting late information and third-party observations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interruption, stay and consolidation of the proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and criteria for interrupting, staying or consolidating EPO proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part E, Chapter VII for grounds and procedures to request or order such measures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time limits, loss of rights, further and accelerated processing and reestablishment of rights
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on time limits, consequences of missed deadlines, accelerated processing and re-establishment (restitutio) of rights.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part E, Chapter VIII for procedural remedies, conditions and documentation requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications under the Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT)
rubrics_metrics.description: Special rules and interaction between PCT procedures and the European patent procedure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part E, Chapter IX for entry into the European phase and related requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decisions; impartiality of the examining or opposition division; appeals
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for drafting decisions, ensuring impartiality of divisions, and appeal procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part E, Chapters X–XII for decision content, conflict-of-interest rules and appeal practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: The European patent application — Content (other than claims)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for the content of a European patent application outside of the claims (description, abstract, drawings etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part F, Chapter II and Annexes (checklist for abstract, units) for specifics and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sufficiency of disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Criterion requiring the application to disclose the invention in a manner sufficiently clear and complete for it to be carried out by a person skilled in the art.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part F, Chapter III for assessment of sufficiency and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claims (Art. 84 and formal requirements)
rubrics_metrics.description: Formal and clarity requirements for claims under Article 84 EPC and EPO practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part F, Chapter IV and Annex for examples concerning essential features and claim drafting guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity of invention (application content)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements regarding unity of invention as it affects application content and allowable claims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part F, Chapter V for criteria and examples of lack of unity and appropriate redress.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and requirements for claiming priority from earlier applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part F, Chapter VI for formalities, time limits and evidentiary requirements for priority claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patentability
rubrics_metrics.description: Overarching assessment of whether subject-matter is patentable under the EPC.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part G, Chapter I for scope and interaction of patentability requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventions; industrial application
rubrics_metrics.description: Definitions and criteria for what constitutes an invention and its industrial applicability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part G, Chapters II–III for tests and examples of industrial applicability.

rubrics_metrics.name: State of the art; non-prejudicial disclosures; novelty
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for defining the state of the art, treatment of non-prejudicial disclosures and assessing novelty.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part G, Chapters IV–VI for rules on prior art, grace periods and novelty assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventive Step
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and approach for assessing inventive step (non-obviousness), including indicators and examples.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part G, Chapter VII and Annex for the problem-solution approach, indicators and illustrative examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: The right to amend; admissibility and allowability of amendments (Art. 123(2) and (3))
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing an applicant's right to amend the application, admissibility of amendments and the allowability test under Article 123(2) and (3) EPC.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part H, Chapters I–V for guidance, examples and correction-of-errors practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correction of errors
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and standards for correction of errors in applications and patents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part H, Chapter VI for correction mechanisms and acceptable corrections.
